justification: `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/typeinference/BoundSet.java` is a very large class (891 lines) with many methods: basic set operations (`withBound`, `isEmpty`, `containsFalse`, `getProperUpperBoundsFor`) plus two large algorithmic responsibilities, `deriveImpliedBounds` (lines 219-490) and `performResolution` (lines 620-826), each containing substantial nested logic and private helpers. This indicates one class is handling both bound storage and multiple complex inference phases, which is a strong sign of insufficient modularization. `TypeInference.java` also uses `BoundSet` across several steps (`withBound`, `deriveImpliedBounds`, `performResolution`), reinforcing that the class centralizes broad type-inference behavior rather than a single cohesive abstraction.
